description: The file contains the implementation of an ADPCM decoder including functions for creating, analyzing, decoding, resetting, and destroying the decoder. It handles the decoding process, maintains decoding statistics, and processes ADPCM frames into PCM samples.

methods.name: adpcm_dec_t * adpcm_decode_create()

methods.description: Processes an input buffer containing an ADPCM frame, stripping headers and preparing data for decoding.

methods.name: bool adpcm_analyze(adpcm_dec_t * decoder,adpcm_t * inbuf,uint32_t inlen,xraudio_adpcm_frame_t * adpcm_frame)
methods.description: Analyzes an ADPCM frame, validates sequence and sample info, and updates the decoder's expected state.

methods.name: int32_t adpcm_decode(adpcm_dec_t * decoder,adpcm_t * inbuf,uint32_t inlen,pcm_t * outbuf,uint32_t outlen,xraudio_adpcm_frame_t * adpcm_frame,bool is_big_endian)
methods.description: Decodes ADPCM data into PCM samples, handling byte order, and ensures output buffer is sufficiently sized.

methods.name: bool adpcm_decode_stats(adpcm_dec_t * decoder,adpcm_decode_stats_t * stats)
methods.description: Retrieves decoding statistics from the decoder instance.

methods.name: bool adpcm_decode_reset(adpcm_dec_t * decoder)

methods.name: void adpcm_decode_destroy(adpcm_dec_t * decoder)
